title: I built a HIGHLY addictive marble race game!
author: liltbrockie
selftext:
Marble Descent is a free marble racing game you play in your browser.

Race solo against five bots, or online - with your friends in a private room, or anyone in a quick race. Or sit back and watch six bots race and pick your winner. Every course comes from a seed: 4.3 billion possible track combinations, no two the same.

Steer left and right, flick up to jump, double-tap to dash and flick down in the air to land heavy! 39 obstacles in all (please suggest number 40 to me !! ), and a ten-round championship with medals and a leaderboard.

Try a similar short, steep course packed with obstacles: [https://marbledescent.co.uk/?seed=POWDER-55032-11479](https://marbledescent.co.uk/?seed=POWDER-55032-11479)

I'm adding to it all the time and I'm open to suggestions: tell me what you'd like to see and there's a good chance it goes in. The Watch AI mode and the see-saws both came from comments on Reddit.

Play free: [https://marbledescent.co.uk](https://marbledescent.co.uk)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/liltbrockie please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
